Your AI bill is too high. The C-suite knows it.

Satya Nadella, Nikesh Arora, Brian Armstrong — some of the biggest names in tech are now publicly saying the same thing: smaller, cheaper AI models can handle most enterprise work.

But here is the real number. 95% of enterprise AI usage still runs on the most expensive frontier models. Meanwhile, routing techniques that use cheaper models for routine tasks and reserve frontier models for complex ones can cut costs by 70 to 90 percent.

That gap between what enterprises are spending and what they should be spending is enormous. And it is closing fast.

Analyst Gil Luria at D.A. Davidson said it plainly: the current growth rates for the big AI labs are the fastest they will ever be. As enterprises get smarter about which model to use where, the economics shift permanently.

The organizations building cost-intelligent AI architectures today will operate at fundamentally different margins than those still defaulting to premium everything.
